hedgehog_spike.note: Ordered pairs (i, j) of I_t with i < j as a Boolean-witness subtype: one spike per unordered pair.

hedgehog_vertex.note: Sum carrier I_t + hedgehog_spike t: body vertices inl i and spike vertices inr s.

hedgehog_edge.note: The tagged triple [set inl i; inl j; inr s] of the spike s = (i, j); always three vertices.

hedgehog_edges.note: Image family of hedgehog_edge over all spikes: one edge per spike, rank three, empty for t < 2.
